body: A set of elegant tasting cups made from raw ore Azure clay. Their simple design allows the color and clarity of the tea to shine.

name: Raw Ore Chicken Blood Dahongpao
body: Made from rare Chicken Blood Dahongpao clay, this Duo Zhi teapot features intricate engraving, making it a true collector's item.

name: Raw Ore Dahongpao Classic Level
body: The Level (Shuiping) teapot is a staple of Gongfu tea. This 130ml version in Dahongpao clay is perfect for high-aroma oolong teas.

name: Raw Ore Dahongpao Round Tasting
body: A simple and elegant round tasting cup made from premium Dahongpao clay. Its smooth finish feels wonderful in the hand.

name: Raw Ore Dicaoqing Bamboo Section
body: Inspired by nature, this bamboo-themed teapot is made from high-quality Dicaoqing clay, known for its subtle texture and rich color.

name: Raw Ore Emerald Green Clay
body: This high Shipiao teapot features delicate hand-painted motifs. The Emerald Green clay provides a unique, vibrant background for the art.

name: Raw Ore Hongpidong High Julun
body: This Julun teapot is made from rare Hongpidong clay. Its tall shape and sturdy handle make it a practical and elegant choice for daily tea rituals.

name: Raw Ore Old Purple Clay
body: The Jinglan (Well Fence) shape is a classic in Zisha art. This version is made from aged purple clay with a wide mouth for easy leaf placement and cleaning.

name: Raw Ore Purple Clay Hexagonal
body: A classic hexagonal tasting cup made from raw ore purple clay. Its angular design provides a modern twist on traditional teaware.

name: Raw Ore Purple Vermilion Clay
body: The Anxiang (Hidden Fragrance) teapot is made from purple vermilion clay. Its refined shape is designed to capture and concentrate tea aromas.

name: Raw Ore Vermilion Clay Dezhong
body: The Dezhong shape represents virtue and balance. This handmade vermilion clay teapot is a masterpiece of symmetry and functional art.

name: Raw Ore Vermilion Clay Pear
body: A delicate pear-shaped teapot, perfect for single-person sessions or small gatherings. The vermilion clay is highly prized for its ability to enhance tea aroma.

name: Retro Style -Lined Business Insulation
marketing_tip: Elegant business design with the benefits of traditional Zisha lining.
body: This professional-grade insulation cup features a Zisha inner liner, ensuring your tea stays at the perfect temperature without losing its delicate flavor profile.

name: Xu Feng Raw Ore Ball
body: Handcrafted from authentic Yixing raw ore clay, this Xi Shi teapot features a unique ball-hole filter for smooth pouring. The clip-lid design ensures a secure fit during the ritual.

name: Yunding Xi Shi Emerald Green
body: A large capacity Xi Shi teapot in Emerald Green clay, perfect for serving larger groups without sacrificing the benefits of Zisha clay.

name: High Mountain Mist Green Tea
marketing_tip: High-quality Huangshan Maofeng at an exceptional value.
body: Sourced directly from high-altitude tea gardens, this "Cloud and Mist" Maofeng offers a clean, refreshing taste. It’s a high-performance tea that provides authentic flavor at a competitive price point.

name: Keemun Black Tea - Corporate
marketing_tip: A refined Keemun black tea set, ideal for employee benefits and corporate gifts.
body: This Keemun black tea is known for its rich, honeyed aroma and smooth, full-bodied flavor. Presented in a professional gift box, it’s a versatile choice for festivals and corporate events.

name: Keemun Black Tea - Lunar
marketing_tip: Celebrate the New Year with a premium selection of diverse Keemun black teas.
body: This festive gift set includes various styles of Keemun black tea, from Xiang Luo to Mao Feng and Jin Zhen. It's a comprehensive tasting experience packaged for holiday gifting.

name: Prestige Taiping Houkui Spring Gift
marketing_tip: A premium 2026 spring harvest of Taiping Houkui, elegantly presented for special occasions.
body: Experience the pinnacle of green tea with our 2026 Taiping Houkui. This high-mountain tea is characterized by its large, flat, emerald leaves and a sophisticated orchid fragrance that lingers on the palate. A truly exceptional gift.

name: Qimen Black Tea Corporate Gift
marketing_tip: A professional and elegant black tea gift set, perfect for clients and business partners.
body: This Qimen black tea gift set is designed for corporate gifting, offering a refined taste of Anhui's famous black tea. The Xiang Luo variety included is known for its tight curls and deep, honeyed flavor profile.

name: Spring Harvest Huangshan Maofeng -
marketing_tip: A generous selection of premium spring Maofeng green tea, ideal for daily enjoyment.
body: Enjoy the fresh, crisp taste of Huangshan Maofeng with this half-pound gift set. These spring-harvested leaves offer a classic green tea experience, with a bright infusion and a clean, floral finish.

name: Yan Yu Tea Talk Taiping
marketing_tip: A sophisticated green tea gift featuring the unique, hand-crafted leaves of Taiping Houkui.
body: Presented in an elegant gift box, this Taiping Houkui green tea is a tribute to traditional craftsmanship. The large, flat leaves unfurl in water to release a refreshing, floral aroma that is characteristic of this esteemed variety.

name: 2019 Spring Lao Ban Zhang
marketing_tip: Authentic ancient tree Puerh from the legendary Lao Ban Zhang village.
body: Sourced from the prestigious Lao Ban Zhang village in Yunnan, this 2019 spring harvest Puerh cake is made from pure ancient tree leaves. It offers a powerful, complex flavor and a strong cha qi that Puerh collectors prize.

name: 2026 Shexian Huangshan Maofeng -
marketing_tip: Freshly harvested spring tea from the historic Shexian region.
body: This 2026 spring harvest Huangshan Maofeng comes from Shexian, one of the core production areas. It offers a classic Maofeng profile with a bright liquor and a sweet, lingering aftertaste.

name: Ancient Tree Palace Ripe
body: High-grade ripe Puer from ancient trees, smooth and earthy with a thick mouthfeel.

name: Anhui High-Mountain Qimen Black Tea
marketing_tip: Discover the diverse profiles of Qimen black tea with this curated collection.
body: This half-pound gift set showcases the finest varieties of Qimen black tea, including Xiang Luo, Maofeng, and Jin Zhen. Each offers a unique balance of honeyed sweetness and floral complexity, perfect for gifting or personal enjoyment.

name: Al Huangshan Maofeng - Daily
marketing_tip: High mountain green tea perfect for your daily wellness ritual.
body: This Huangshan Maofeng is hand-kneaded and sourced from high-altitude gardens. It’s a versatile tea that works well for daily drinking or as a thoughtful, health-conscious gift.

name: Al Huangshan Maofeng Green Tea
marketing_tip: Exquisite high-mountain Maofeng, hand-processed for a pure and refreshing taste.
body: Sourced from the prestigious Huangshan region, this Maofeng green tea is celebrated for its tender leaves and delicate orchid fragrance. An ideal choice for those who appreciate the subtle nuances of premium spring tea.

name: Biluochun
body: Green Snail Spring tea, famous for its tiny, curled leaves covered in white down and intense floral-fruity aroma.

name: Bulang Mountain Ancient Tree Mellow
marketing_tip: From the legendary Bulang Mountain comes this "Bulang Mellow" ripe Pu-erh, known for its bold strength and exceptionally smooth, sweet mouthfeel.
body: Bulang Mountain is famed for the powerful and assertive character of its tea. This ancient tree ripe Pu-erh cake, produced in Menghai, undergoes a meticulous fermentation process to transform that strength into a deep, mellow richness. It yields a dark, lustrous infusion with notes of dried fruit and wood, delivering a full-bodied experience that is both grounding and uplifting.

name: Early Spring Special Grade Huangshan
marketing_tip: The finest first-pick Maofeng for a delicate and aromatic brew.
body: Harvested at the very start of the spring season, this special grade Huangshan Maofeng offers a level of refinement and complexity that is highly sought after. A perfect gift for true tea enthusiasts.

name: First-Harvest Hand-Processed Huangshan Maofeng
marketing_tip: Exquisite first-harvest green tea, hand-crafted using traditional mountain techniques.
body: This Maofeng green tea is harvested at the very beginning of spring. Each leaf is hand-processed to ensure the perfect balance of flavor and fragrance, resulting in a tea that is both invigorating and soothing.

name: Imperial Palace Grade Ancient Tree
marketing_tip: Experience the regal richness of Imperial-grade ripe Pu-erh, aged to perfection with distinct camphor undertones and a velvet-smooth finish.
body: This "Gong Ting" (Imperial Palace) grade ripe Pu-erh is crafted from fine buds harvested from ancient tea trees. It boasts a deep, earthy liquor with a unique camphor aroma that emerges through careful aging. The texture is exceptionally thick and creamy, offering a comforting warmth and a long-lasting, soothing sweetness.

name: Imperial Taiping Houkui Grand Cru
marketing_tip: A prestigious high-mountain green tea with an elegant floral aroma and smooth texture.
body: This exceptional Taiping Houkui is harvested from high-altitude gardens in the Huangshan area. Each leaf is a masterpiece of artisanal production, resulting in a tea that is as beautiful to look at as it is delicious to drink.

name: Jasmine Dragon Pearls
body: Hand-rolled green tea pearls scented multiple times with fresh jasmine flowers for a sweet, floral infusion.

name: Keemun Black Tea - Floral
marketing_tip: 2026 new harvest Keemun black tea with rich honey and orchid notes.
body: This premium Keemun Jin Zhen (Golden Needle) black tea is harvested in 2026. It features a complex profile of floral, fruity, and honeyed notes, making it a standout choice for black tea lovers.

name: Kunlu Mountain 2019 First Spring
marketing_tip: A rare find from the mist-covered slopes of Kunlu Mountain, this 2019 vintage offers a pristine, unadulterated taste of pure old-growth tea trees.
body: This exquisite raw Pu-erh tea cake was harvested during the first spring of 2019 in the renowned Kunlu Mountain region. Known for its elegant floral aroma and lingering sweet aftertaste (hui gan), this pure-material tea has been carefully pressed into a 200g cake, perfect for aging or immediate enjoyment by tea connoisseurs.

name: Old Stone Path 2019 Ancient
marketing_tip: Journey through time with every sip of this 2019 ancient tree harvest, characterized by its robust character and complex depth.
body: Sourced from ancient tea trees along the traditional "Old Stone Path" (Jiu Shi Ma), this 357g raw Pu-erh cake represents the pinnacle of traditional craftsmanship. The 2019 vintage has developed a smooth, mellow profile while retaining the vibrant energy and multi-layered complexity typical of high-altitude ancient groves.

name: Orchid-Scented Taiping Houkui Reserve
marketing_tip: A premium selection of hand-pinched Taiping Houkui with a distinct orchid fragrance.
body: This half-pound gift set features Taiping Houkui leaves known for their 'Orchid Fragrance'. Carefully hand-pinched to preserve their integrity, these leaves produce a bright, flavorful tea that is a favorite among green tea lovers.

name: Osmanthus-Scented Qimen Black Tea Blend
marketing_tip: A fragrant blend of Qimen black tea and golden osmanthus flowers, offering a uniquely floral experience.
body: Indulge in the sweet, apricot-like aroma of osmanthus perfectly balanced with the malty depth of Qimen black tea. This scented blend is packaged in convenient canisters, making it an ideal companion for a relaxing afternoon tea ritual.

name: Huangshan Maofeng - High Mountain
marketing_tip: High mountain grown Maofeng with a smooth, lingering finish.
body: Sourced from high-altitude tea gardens in Huangshan, this Maofeng green tea is carefully kneaded to release its full aromatic potential. It offers a clean, refreshing taste that represents the best of Anhui tea culture.

name: Qimen 'Zong' Black Tea -
marketing_tip: Individually wrapped in bamboo leaves for a unique, earthy infusion.
body: Experience the traditional 'Zong' style Qimen black tea. The tea leaves are bundled in bamboo leaves, which imparts a subtle, woody depth to the classic honey and fruit notes of Qimen tea. A wonderful gift for tea explorers.

name: Roasted Tieguanyin
body: Traditional charcoal-roasted Tieguanyin with deep, nutty, and roasted notes.

name: Silver Needle
body: Bai Hao Yin Zhen, the highest grade of white tea, consisting only of young spring buds covered in silver down.

name: Spring Harvest Huangshan Maofeng Green
marketing_tip: Fresh 2026 Huangshan Maofeng, a delicate green tea with a sweet, orchid-like fragrance.
body: Harvested from the misty peaks of Huangshan, this premium Maofeng green tea is carefully hand-processed to maintain its tender buds and refreshing taste. A perfect spring gift for tea connoisseurs.

name: Superfine Huangshan Maofeng Green Tea
marketing_tip: The ultimate expression of Huangshan Maofeng, featuring the most delicate spring buds.
body: Harvested before the Qingming Festival, this superfine Huangshan Maofeng represents the highest grade of green tea. Its slender, silver-tipped leaves produce a sweet, lingering taste with a refreshing orchid aroma.

name: Taiping Houkui Green Tea -
marketing_tip: Authentic Taiping Houkui with a distinctive orchid aroma.
body: Experience the unique character of Taiping Houkui, a renowned Chinese green tea. These leaves are hand-pinched and processed to preserve their large, flat shape and exquisite floral notes. Perfect for daily enjoyment or gifting.

name: West Lake Longjing
body: The iconic West Lake Dragon Well tea, known for its four perfections: green color, flat shape, orchid aroma, and sweet taste.

name: Wuyi Dahongpao
body: The King of Wuyi Rock teas, known for its complex 'Yan Yun' (Rock Rhyme) and deep charcoal-roasted aroma.

name: Wuyi Rougui
body: Wuyi Rougui, famous for its sharp, cinnamon-like spice and long-lasting floral aftertaste.

name: Xiaoqinggan
body: Mini green citrus stuffed with ripe Puer tea, a perfect balance of citrus brightness and tea depth.

name: Yan Yu Tea Talk Huangshan
marketing_tip: Pure Huangshan Maofeng, sourced directly from the origin for unparalleled freshness.
body: An authentic green tea experience from the heart of Huangshan. This Maofeng is characterized by its tender green buds and a clean, refreshing taste that evokes the misty mountain air of its birthplace.

name: Yunnan "Purple Cuckoo" Dian Hong
marketing_tip: A rare "Zijuan" (Purple Cuckoo) variety black tea, offering an enchanting fusion of wildflower fragrance and luscious honey sweetness.
body: This premium Dian Hong (Yunnan Black Tea) is made from the unique "Zijuan" purple-leaf cultivar, known for its high anthocyanin content and distinctive flavor profile. The tea is expertly processed to bring out intense floral aromas and a rich, honeyed sweetness. Each 500g portion provides a smooth, refreshing cup with a beautiful reddish-amber hue and a clean, revitalizing finish.

name: Yunnan Dianhong
body: Golden Bud Dianhong from Yunnan, offering a rich, malty, and honey-sweet flavor profile.

name: Yunnan Puerh Ripe Tea Cake
marketing_tip: A commemorative 357g ripe Puerh cake celebrating a decade of excellence.
body: This special edition ripe Puerh tea cake was produced to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the cooperative. It features a smooth, earthy profile with a rich liquor, perfect for aging or immediate enjoyment.

name: Anti-Crack Round Zen Tray
marketing_tip: Engineered to never warp or crack, even with constant water exposure.
body: A compact round tea tray that excels in both form and function. Its bakelite construction is completely resistant to the elements, while the internal reservoir keeps your table dry.

name: Hand-Lacquered Mural Tea Tray
marketing_tip: A collectible masterpiece of traditional lacquer art and Zen aesthetics.
body: Hand-lacquered by master artisans, this tray features stunning mural art. It is not just teaware, but a piece of oriental heritage for the serious collector.

name: Classic German Bakelite Dry Pour
marketing_tip: Seamlessly combines traditional Chinese style with high-performance German materials.
body: This square dry pour table is crafted from premium bakelite, offering a wood-like appearance with none of the cracking or warping. Perfect for daily home use.

name: Eggshell Mosaic 'Lotus Pond' Tray
marketing_tip: Rare eggshell inlay technique creates a vibrant, tactile lotus scene.
body: A masterpiece of craftsmanship using real eggshell fragments to create a stunning lotus and bird mosaic. This lacquer tray is a luxurious addition to any Zen tea ritual.

name: -Standard Integrated Bakelite Tray
marketing_tip: Robust performance at an unbeatable factory-direct value.
body: A standard-sized, integrated square bakelite tray designed for heavy use. Its simple, efficient design is perfect for both wholesale and everyday home use.

name: Hand-Polished Rhino-Skin Lacquer Tray
marketing_tip: Hand-polished to a mirror finish, reflecting the soul of the tea ceremony.
body: This lacquer tray features the distinctive 'rhino-skin' pattern, achieved through multiple layers of hand-application and polishing. Includes a drainage port for convenience.

name: Integrated Bakelite Tea Sea
marketing_tip: Direct from the factory quality for a robust and elegant tea session.
body: A minimalist integrated square tea tray that serves as a beautiful 'tea sea'. Its durable bakelite construction ensures it remains a centerpiece of your teaware for years.

name: Minimalist Square Bakelite Tea Tray
marketing_tip: German-engineered bakelite for ultimate durability and heat resistance.
body: A high-quality bakelite tea tray designed for professional tea ceremonies. This square integrated tray features efficient drainage and a sleek, modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Light Luxury Drainage Tray
marketing_tip: Light luxury design meets modern drainage efficiency.
body: This compact tea tray blends modern Chinese style with practical drainage features. Made from high-grade materials that mimic the feel of solid wood.

name: Mother-Of-Pearl Inlay Lacquer Tray
marketing_tip: Exquisite mother-of-pearl inlays paired with rare red rhino-skin texture.
body: A luxury dry-pour tray showcasing the peak of Oriental aesthetics. The intricate inlay work and lacquer finish make it a stunning decorative piece for any tea space.

name: Lacquer 'Flying Bird' Round Tray
marketing_tip: Natural raw lacquer with delicate hand-painted bird motifs.
body: A round dry-pour tray finished with natural raw lacquer. The 'flying bird' pattern adds a poetic touch to the deep black background, embodying oriental elegance.

name: Square Bakelite Drainage Table
marketing_tip: Elegant square silhouette with superior water drainage for a clean table.
body: Crafted from high-density German-tech bakelite, this square tray offers the warmth of wood with the durability of modern composites. Features a sophisticated drainage system.

name: Ru Kiln Heritage With Tray
marketing_tip: A complete heritage experience, featuring the serene beauty of Ru Kiln celadon and a matching tray.
body: This comprehensive set includes everything needed for a formal gongfu tea ceremony, all finished in a classic Ru Kiln glaze. The matching tray ensures a clean workspace, while the celadon's calming hue sets a tranquil mood.
